approvalBasis: Explicit owner instruction on 2026-09-14 to make recipient priority and progressive evidence-gated rollout a platform-wide rule.
summary: Establish primary sovereign user -> relational users -> third-party users, prioritizing need/access-vulnerable third parties, with four rollout stages and six mandatory evidence gates.

rollback.method: Revert this amendment commit and restore constitution 1.16.0 after constitutional approval.
rollback.audienceSafety: A rollback must not broaden audience exposure; current rollout stage is preserved or narrowed until reverified.
